# vercel-static (auto-generated — do not edit by hand)

This branch contains the prebuilt Flutter web output (`flutter build web
--release --base-href "/"`) with `index.html` at the root, so Vercel can
serve it as a plain static site (Framework Preset: Other, no Build Command,
Output Directory: `./`).

Source of truth is the `main` branch. To republish after changing the app,
run from `main`:

```powershell
.\deploy-vercel.ps1
```
